hook: I want to know what's happening in my case **without going to court.**
hook_q: How do I check my court case status online?

slides.title: District court case? Use **eCourts.**
slides.body: The eCourts Services portal (services.ecourts.gov.in) covers District and Taluka Courts. Search by case number, party name, advocate name, FIR number, filing number or Act.

slides.title: Your **CNR number** is the key.
slides.body: CNR (Case Number Record) is a unique number given to each case. Enter the 16-character CNR without hyphens or spaces, for example MHAU019999992015.

slides.title: Prefer your phone? **Get the app.**
list: eCourts Services app on Google Play and Apple App Store
Covers High Courts and District Courts
Save cases under "My Cases" to track them

slides.title: No internet? **Send an SMS.**
slides.body: Type ECOURTS, a space, and your CNR number, and send it to 9766899899. The case details come back to you by SMS.
slides.ref: Dept of Justice & eCommittee · eCourts brochure

slides.title: Supreme Court case? Check **sci.gov.in.**
slides.body: The Supreme Court's case status page lets you search by Diary Number, Case Number, CNR Number, AOR Code, Party Name or Court. It also has an official app.

sources: eCommittee, Supreme Court of India (ecommitteesci.gov.in) – eCourts Services portal, mobile app, SMS Pull

caption:
Want to track your court case from home? Here's how. 👇

1️⃣ District/Taluka court case: search on services.ecourts.gov.in by case number, party name, advocate or FIR number
2️⃣ Have your 16-character CNR number? Enter it without hyphens or spaces
3️⃣ The free eCourts Services app covers High Courts and District Courts. Save cases under "My Cases"
4️⃣ No internet? SMS ECOURTS <space> your CNR number to 9766899899
5️⃣ Supreme Court case: check the case status page on sci.gov.in

Source: eCommittee, Supreme Court of India; Department of Justice (eCourts); Supreme Court of India
